visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a white patterned shirt stands in front of a television, wearing a small white rectangular patch vertically over the center of his lips. He looks directly at the camera with a wide-eyed, slightly surprised expression, touching his face with one hand. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit retail shelf in Japan, showcasing various blue and purple packages of sleep-aid products with illustrations of people sleeping. A hand moves through the frame, pointing at specific items on the shelf. (3) The man returns to the screen in his home setting, now holding a purple and yellow product package. He opens the package with his hands, removes a single white adhesive strip, and demonstrates applying it to his mouth while speaking. He then makes various facial expressions and touches the patch to test its adhesion, looking at the camera with a humorous smile.

The creator uses high-energy narration and on-location footage from a store to build context before demonstrating the product's use and effectiveness at home, ultimately engaging the audience with a question about its validity.
